doc: Camera and microphone capture and recording (LCP-038), under the permission pattern: availability, permission state and each request's outcome are kept apart. A MediaStream, a track, a recorder or a Blob never crosses the boundary. The engine holds an opaque capture id, may show it in a <video data-media-preview> the HTML names, and reads a finished recording in bounded slices. Nothing is requested at initialization: only startCapture can make the browser prompt. Every long-lived resource ends explicitly: stop, release, a cancelled capture, and the provider's own disposal all stop every track.

constants.name: MAX_READ_BYTES
constants.doc: The largest single read of a recording, in bytes.

types.name: DeviceProblem
types.doc: notFound: no such device (or none at all); inUse: the device exists but could not be started, usually because another application holds it; overconstrained: no device satisfies what was asked.

types.name: CaptureId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

types.name: RecordingId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

types.name: DeviceInfo
types.doc: deviceId is the browser's per-origin identifier. label is empty until the user has granted access, as the browser decides.

types.name: PreviewTarget
types.doc: A <video> named in HTML by data-media-preview; key selects a row by the nearest data-media-key ancestor.

variants.name: permission
variants.doc: The current permission state, without asking.

variants.name: watchPermission
variants.doc: PermissionChanged facts follow until unwatchPermission.

variants.name: devices
variants.doc: The devices the browser lists. DevicesChanged facts follow any change.

variants.name: startCapture
variants.doc: Start the camera, the microphone or both. May show the browser's permission prompt. audioDevice and videoDevice ask for exactly that device.

variants.name: preview
variants.doc: Show a capture in the named <video>, muted. One capture per element; a new preview replaces the old.

variants.name: stop
variants.doc: Stop every track of a capture, end any recording of it, clear its previews and release the id.

variants.name: record
variants.doc: Start recording a live capture. mimeType, if given, must be one this browser can record.

variants.name: finish
variants.doc: Stop a recording; answers with its size once the browser has delivered every byte.

variants.name: read
variants.doc: Read length bytes (1 to MAX_READ_BYTES) of a finished recording from offset, as base64.

variants.name: release
variants.doc: Discard a recording, stopping it first if it is still running.

variants.name: Permission
variants.doc: state is absent when this browser cannot report it.

variants.name: CannotWatch
variants.doc: This browser cannot report permission changes.

variants.name: NothingRequested
variants.doc: startCapture with neither audio nor video.

variants.name: NotFound
variants.doc: No element carries that preview name (and key).

variants.name: WrongElement
variants.doc: The named element is not a <video>.

variants.name: Denied
variants.doc: The user or the browser refused this origin the device.

variants.name: CaptureEnded
variants.doc: The capture's tracks have all ended, so it cannot be recorded or previewed.

variants.name: NotRecordable
variants.doc: This browser cannot record that type (or cannot record at all).

variants.name: StillRecording
variants.doc: A read of a recording that has not been finished. (release always succeeds: it stops the recording first.)

variants.name: Cancelled
variants.doc: The engine cancelled the request. A capture that arrives afterwards is stopped at once and never reported.

variants.name: Failed
variants.doc: The browser failed in a way none of the above names. reason is its error name.

variants.name: PermissionChanged
variants.doc: A revocation is previous granted, state prompt or denied.

variants.name: DevicesChanged
variants.doc: A device was added or removed; ask devices again.

variants.name: TrackEnded
variants.doc: The browser ended one track of a capture (a device unplugged, access revoked).

variants.name: CaptureEnded
variants.doc: Every track of the capture has ended. The id stays valid until stop.

variants.name: RecordingInterrupted
variants.doc: The browser stopped a recording the engine had not finished (its capture ended, or recording failed). finish still answers with what was recorded.
